description: The single-line text field: label, invalid state and the shared control tokens. A screen never renders a bare input.

props.name: surface
props.description: Which surface the field sits on. On `muted` (a page/PageHeader) the border is dropped since the white fill separates it; `base` (default, a white card or form) keeps the border. Invalid + focus stay visible on both.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height: sm / md (default) / lg — matches the button/control scale.
